recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing an enumerated Task target profile would be redundant with the current Reference(Resource) representation and could create future maintenance drift.
issue_request: FHIR-32289 was a Published/Persuasive Security change request for R5 asking that Task be added to the allowed basedOn references for both AuditEvent and Provenance because Task can serve as a workflow authorization resource.
initial_application: The request was applied in source commit 8209c17a869cab7d8ebb44b093fd235edf90c1c6, which explicitly says "FHIR-32289 - add task to .basedOn" and added Task target profiles to AuditEvent.basedOn and Provenance.basedOn. That same historical commit also included the unrelated FHIR-32454 agent.who change.
additional_context: AuditEvent, Provenance, and Task are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Security cleanup reworked the basedOn target profile list, and commit 312dae9b1544dff8b853b100b66c2d663eb0cee0 replaced the concrete request-resource subset with Reference(Resource) while preserving Task in the commented request-resource list. Workflow and Security meeting evidence aligns with the Jira disposition and revealed no contrary decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the authoritative current definitions are broader than the original requested addition and already include Task.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same historical source commit, but it concerns AuditEvent/Provenance agent.who target types rather than basedOn.
